Politics · India

Ethanol Fuel Blending Sparks Debate on Vehicle Impact and Future Plans

India is experiencing increased discussion and debate surrounding ethanol-blended petrol, particularly the E20 blend. Some vehicle owners claim that ethanol-blended petrol negatively impacts car mileage and engines, while the government asserts it is a safe step towards reducing reliance on imported fuel. Union Minister Nitin Gadkari has defended the E20 fuel policy, challenging critics to provide evidence of vehicle damage. Meanwhile, discussions are underway regarding potential future blends like E25, with some automakers reportedly appealing for caution. The government states that E10-compliant vehicles will not face issues with E20 fuel, and tests for E25 are ongoing.
